title: A limited worker pool
description:
Let at most 3 jobs run at once with a counting semaphore.

```
10 jobs, limit 3
running at most: 3
all 10 finished
```
hints: After `++running`, update the peak with a compare-exchange loop or `peak = std::max(peak.load(), running.load())` (not exact, but fine here) (lesson 4.03).
A small `struct Slot { Slot() { slots.acquire(); } ~Slot() { slots.release(); } };` guarantees the release.
requirements: `std::counting_semaphore<3>`; each job `acquire`s before running and `release`s after.
Count the jobs running at the same time with an atomic and record the maximum.
Use RAII so a job that throws still releases.
stretch: Use a named Windows semaphore (`CreateSemaphoreW`) so the limit works across processes.
